structure.unit: State Authorities, Boards, Commissions, Councils, Foundations and Other Collegial Bodies

law.catch_line: Exemption of Authority from personnel and procurement procedures
law.text: The provisions of the Virginia Personnel Act (§ 2.2-2900 et seq.) and the Virginia Public Procurement Act (§ 2.2-4300 et seq.) shall not apply to the Authority in the exercise of any power conferred under this article.
